title: Brief 6: four agents measured, one marathon session
when: 9 November 2026, 17:45 UTC (window: since brief 5, 8 November 17:39 UTC)
headline: 4,442,069 fresh tokens and 164 million cache reads from four agents; the biggest saving is still fresh sessions (A6), now with prompter's day as the clearest case: context per call grew from 92,085 to 716,897 tokens.

stats.label: tokens today (fresh input + output + cache writes)
fresh saving per day from A6 (my estimate)

for_you.ask: A fresh session per wake for dashboard, dev and me, and per task for prompter (brief 5, stronger evidence)?
for_you.detail: dashboard: 3 wakes, 693,416 of 700,403 fresh tokens were re-loading, for 6,964 tokens of output. dev's quiet 15:38 wake ('Angelo not yet answered'): 371,156 fresh, up from 206,199 yesterday. prompter: one session all day, context per call 92,085 rising to 716,897; 139.9 million cache reads. Old: each scheduled task fires into one standing session. New: create_new_session_on_fire, same prompt; prompter starts a new session per task. Saving about 1.3 million fresh tokens a day, plus most of prompter's cache reads (my estimate, confirmed over three wakes).

for_you.ask: Test dashboard's wake on Sonnet 5.5 (replaces A2 as the first model test)?
for_you.detail: It repeats three times a day, writes about 2,300 tokens, and passed every time on Opus 5.5. One run on Sonnet 5.5 in a scratch folder, scored blind against today's output. Under 200,000 tokens, once.

sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: Marathon session (prompter): its 13:50 wake made 177 calls carrying 552,656 tokens of context each; 97.8 million cache reads in one wake. A new session per task (A6).
Re-loading (dashboard, dev, me): 99% of dashboard's fresh tokens and 97% of dev's are cache writes re-loading old context. A6.
Model fit (dashboard): a short, repeating, passing task on the largest model. Test on Sonnet 5.5 first (A7).

sections.title: 3. Model tests run
sections.text: None yet: A7 waits on your yes.

sections.title: 4. Agents not yet measuring
sections.text: Told to their conductor (every one asked once): conductor, designer, messaging, factory, builder, ux, journalist, social. prompter asked to fix its --since windows (commit today).

sections.title: 5. Data notes and 6. My own use
sections.text: * prompter: 11 lines, 5 inside a wider window, so 6 counted; its 7 sub-agents counted once (500,082). Estimates labelled. Inbox report for 8 Nov sent; today's sent this wake. My use: brief 7.

friendly.title: Your agents' token use, 9 November
friendly.summary: Four agents report now. The pattern is clear: each one lives in one long session that grows all day. Prompter's grew to about 717,000 tokens carried on every step. Fresh sessions (A6) are the big fix.
